Class Controller

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.controller.Controller
public class Controller extends Object
Core server-side controller managing a single game instance. Responsibilities: - Intercepts requests from clients (via Socket or RMI handlers). - Forwards actions to the Game model in a thread-safe (synchronized) manner. - Manages the player lifecycle (joins, disconnections, reconnections). - Handles game persistence, state saving, and automated endgame scoring.

    • handleJoinGame

      public void handleJoinGame(String nickname, ClientConnection connection)
      Handles the entry of a client. Distinguishes three cases: reconnection of a dropped player (delegated to handleReconnect(String, ClientConnection)), duplicate nickname (rejected with an error), and standard entry (creates the VirtualView, registers it as a model observer, and forwards the join to the Game).
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's nickname
      connection - the client's connection (Socket or RMI)

    • handleReconnect

      public void handleReconnect(String nickname, ClientConnection connection)
      Restores a player who reconnects within the valid time window: removes them from the disconnected list, replaces their VirtualView with that of the new connection, resends the full state snapshot (and the current turn), notifies others of the reentry, and, if the game was suspended with >= 2 active players, resumes it. If the game is already over, it replicates the final result to them.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the reconnecting player
      connection - the new client connection

    • validateGameStateAfterRecovery

      public void validateGameStateAfterRecovery()
      After a recovery from a crash, realigns the current player by asking the current state who should act (recoverActivePlayer) and logs the recovered phase.
